latest_release.name: CNTK version 2.7 (Windows+Linux)
latest_release.body:
This release of the Microsoft Cognitive Toolkit (CNTK) supports both **Windows** and **Linux** on **64bit** platforms.

This release contains versions for both **GPU** and **CPU-only** systems.

See [Release Notes](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/cognitive-toolkit/ReleaseNotes/CNTK_2_7_Release_Notes) or download them as a separate file using the link below.

To set up this release on your system, please read the Install instructions in the root of the corresponding archive and [Binary Setup instructions in CNTK Wiki](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/cognitive-toolkit/Setup-CNTK-on-your-machine).

### Windows

---
- [CNTK for Windows v.2.7 CPU only](https://cntk.ai/dlwc-2.7.html)
- [CNTK for Windows v.2.7 GPU](https://cntk.ai/dlwg-2.7.html)
- NuGet Packages:
  - [CNTK, CPU-Only Build](https://www.nuget.org/packages/CNTK.CPUOnly/2.7.0)
  - [CNTK, GPU Build](https://www.nuget.org/packages/CNTK.GPU/2.7.0)
  - [CNTK, UWP CPU-Only Build](http://www.nuget.org/packages/CNTK.UWP.CPUOnly/2.7.0)
  - [CNTK CPU-only Model Evaluation Libraries (MKL based)](http://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.Research.CNTK.CpuEval-mkl/2.7.0)
    Package description and instructions are [here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/cognitive-toolkit/NuGet-Package).

### Linux

---

- [CNTK for Linux v.2.7 CPU only](https://cntk.ai/dllc-2.7.html)
- [CNTK for Linux v.2.7 GPU](https://cntk.ai/dllg-2.7.html)
*Images at Docker Hub are coming soon*
